services.name: Cape Cod Sportfishing
services.desc: Pricing and booking options. Discover the thrill of reeling in your catch with St. Pete Sportfishing. Choose your ideal trip and set sail from beautiful Bass River Marina. Experience the best of Cape Cod fishing with our expertly guided trips. Whether you’re a seasoned angler chasing striped bass or a family looking for a fun day catching sea bass, we have the perfect adventure tailored to your skill level and preferences. All our trips launch from the conveniently located Bass River Marina in West Dennis, MA, ensuring easy access to prime fishing grounds. Plan your fishing adventure with St. Pete Sportfishing for the current season. Select from half-day excursions to full-day deep-sea

quotes.author: Charlie Anderson
quotes.text: My son and I went out on a warm, calm afternoon. Not classic fishing weather or time of day. Captain Doug and Mate Joe got us on the fish anyway and we brought in a haul of striped bass. What a day! These guys know how to get on the fish. Period.

quotes.author: Katherine Everson
quotes.text: Captain Doug and first mate Bob are amazing and so knowledgeable! They were so encouraging and patient with our three boys who got an exceptional introduction to their first fishing charter. We caught a ton of fish and had three happy boys!

quotes.author: Daniel Taylor
quotes.text: We had an epic morning fishing with Captain Doug and first mate Joe. We caught and released 23 stripers, nearly all 30 plus inches in size with our largest at 40 inches. Highly recommend St Pete Sport Fishing.

quotes.author: Kevin Conklin
quotes.text: My son and I booked a 6-hour striper trip with CAPT Doug on July 23. We stayed busy catching more than 20 quality fish, a few exceeding 36”. It was one of the best experiences we’ve had fishing the cape.

quotes.author: Collin Kimple
quotes.text: Unbelivable day on the water with Captain Doug, second trip with him and my forearms are still burning from all the fish we reeled in!

quotes.author: Jeff OB
quotes.text: Caught a bunch of stripers🐟🐟🐟. Great captain/ great deckhand. We had a lot of fun. A day to remember 💓
